versos.texto_bv: dos filhos de Selomite, o filho de Josifias, e com ele cento e sessenta homens;
versos.traducao_literal: e dos filhos de Selomite: filho de Josifias, e com ele cento e sessenta, os homens;
objecoes: Objeção MATERIAL (revisão ER-0019): Nome do clã ancestral omitido na BV — evidência: ARA: "dos filhos de Bani, Selomite"; NVIPT: "dos descendentes de Bani, Selomite". BV e traducao_literal omitem o clã Bani. Correção exige adição de conteúdo.

kjv.texto: And of the sons of Shelomith; the son of Josiphiah, and with him an hundred and threescore males.

vizinhos.9: Of the sons of Joab; Obadiah the son of Jehiel, and with him two hundred and eighteen males.
vizinhos.11: And of the sons of Bebai; Zechariah the son of Bebai, and with him twenty and eight males.

web.texto: Of the sons of Shelomith, the son of Josiphiah; and with him one hundred sixty males.

vizinhos.9: Of the sons of Joab, Obadiah the son of Jehiel; and with him two hundred and eighteen males.
vizinhos.11: Of the sons of Bebai, Zechariah the son of Bebai; and with him twenty-eight males.

versos.texto_bv: dos filhos de Bigvai, Utai e Zacur, e com ele setenta homens.
versos.traducao_literal: e dos filhos de Bigvai: Utai e Zacur, e com ele setenta, os homens.
objecoes: Objeção MATERIAL (revisão ER-0019): Divergência de nome próprio não verificável sem consulta ao hebraico — evidência: BV: "Zacur"; ARA: "Zabude"; NVIPT: "Zabude". Se forem pessoas diferentes, há erro de nome na BV. A traducao_literal também tem "Zacur", indicando que a fonte da BV continha esse nome.

kjv.texto: Of the sons also of Bigvai; Uthai, and Zabbud, and with them seventy males.

vizinhos.13: And of the last sons of Adonikam, whose names are these, Eliphelet, Jeiel, and Shemaiah, and with them threescore males.
vizinhos.15: And I gathered them together to the river that runneth to Ahava; and there abode we in tents three days: and I viewed the people, and the priests, and found there none of the sons of Levi.

web.texto: Of the sons of Bigvai, Uthai and Zabbud; and with them seventy males.

vizinhos.13: Of the sons of Adonikam, who were the last; and these are their names: Eliphelet, Jeuel, and Shemaiah; and with them sixty males.
vizinhos.15: I gathered them together to the river that runs to Ahava; and there we encamped three days: and I viewed the people, and the priests, and found there none of the sons of Levi.

versos.texto_bv: Chegamos a Jerusalém e permanecemos ali três dias.
versos.traducao_literal: E chegamos a Jerusalém, e permanecemos ali três dias.
objecoes: Objeção MATERIAL (revisão ER-0019): Perda de precisão semântica: verbo não transmite sentido de descanso — evidência: NTLH: "descansamos"; ARA: "repousamos"; NVIPT: "ficamos descansando". Traducao_literal suporta "descansamos". BV usa "permanecemos" (ficar/continuar), que perde a noção de repouso após a viagem. Correção para "descansamos" alteraria o lexema escolhido — é mudança semântica, não de forma.

kjv.texto: And we came to Jerusalem, and abode there three days.

vizinhos.31: Then we departed from the river of Ahava on the twelfth day of the first month, to go unto Jerusalem: and the hand of our God was upon us, and he delivered us from the hand of the enemy, and of such as lay in wait by the way.
vizinhos.33: Now on the fourth day was the silver and the gold and the vessels weighed in the house of our God by the hand of Meremoth the son of Uriah the priest; and with him was Eleazar the son of Phinehas; and with them was Jozabad the son of Jeshua, and Noadiah the son of Binnui, Levites;

web.texto: We came to Jerusalem, and stayed there three days.

vizinhos.31: Then we departed from the river Ahava on the twelfth day of the first month, to go to Jerusalem: and the hand of our God was on us, and he delivered us from the hand of the enemy and the bandit by the way.
vizinhos.33: On the fourth day the silver and the gold and the vessels were weighed in the house of our God into the hand of Meremoth the son of Uriah the priest; and with him was Eleazar the son of Phinehas; and with them was Jozabad the son of Jeshua, and Noadiah the son of Binnui, the Levite;

versos.texto_bv: dos filhos de Secanias, o filho de Jaaziel, e com ele trezentos homens;
versos.traducao_literal: dos filhos de Secanias: filho de Jaaziel, e com ele trezentos, os homens;
objecoes: Objeção MATERIAL (revisão ER-0019): Nome do clã ancestral omitido na BV — evidência: ARA e NVIPT incluem "dos filhos de Zatu" antes de Secanias; BV e traducao_literal omitem o nome do clã. A correção exige adição de conteúdo não presente na fonte da BV.

kjv.texto: Of the sons of Shechaniah; the son of Jahaziel, and with him three hundred males.

vizinhos.4: Of the sons of Pahath–moab; Elihoenai the son of Zerahiah, and with him two hundred males.
vizinhos.6: Of the sons also of Adin; Ebed the son of Jonathan, and with him fifty males.
